'''House Frayus''' was a minor [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] noble house that was led by its matriarch [[Dariana Frayus]] at the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]].
